units.source_text: ①《三个残疾人》，是日本狂言剧目之一。

en.t: The Three Disabled Men is one of the plays in the Japanese kyogen repertoire.

units.source_text: 描写三个人化装为瞎子、哑巴和瘫子，趁财主不在家，打开酒仓纵值痛饮，

en.t: It depicts three men disguising themselves as a blind man, a mute man, and a paralyzed man, then taking advantage of a wealthy man's absence to open his wine storehouse and drink their fill,

units.source_text: 待财主回来后，三个慌得乱作一团，竟弄错了各自扮演的角色。

en.t: and when the wealthy man returns, the three panic and fall into complete confusion, even mixing up the roles they are supposed to be playing.
